description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ConfigurationInterface' within the namespace 'Aws	ernalsMode'. The interface provides method signatures for accessing various configuration settings related to AWS SDK default modes, including mode type, regional endpoints, connection timeouts, and the full configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface defining methods to access default mode configurations within AWS SDK.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the configuration mode, which can be 'legacy', 'standard', or 'adaptive'.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if STS regional endpoints are enabled.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if S3 US-East-1 regional endpoints are enabled.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the entire configuration as an associative array.
